name: clean-code
description: Language-neutral skills for visualizing, designing, building, testing, and verifying maintainable software.
author: Clean Code contributors

interface.longDescription: Clean Code combines concise visual explanation and software design guidance with deterministic verification, independent testing, architecture checks, and evidence-based review for repositories in any language.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me design, build, test, and verify this change using Clean Code.
